data.case_title: Rejection of electric wheelchair request (Elektrorollstuhl) by health insurer
data.title: Decision: Elektrorollstuhl request rejected
data.summary: Beispielkasse Ersatzkrankenkasse decided on 20 November 2026 that it will not provide an electric wheelchair (Elektrorollstuhl) to Bastian Musterquell, because the Medical Service (Medizinischer Dienst) found he can manage short distances at home with a rollator; instead it approved a wheelchair with pushing aid (Schiebehilfe) for a companion to use on longer distances.
data.explanation: Your health insurer has turned down the electric wheelchair you applied for and approved a manual wheelchair with a pushing aid instead, based on the medical assessment. If you disagree with this decision, you can file a written objection (Widerspruch) with the insurer, or have it recorded in person at their office. The app will show you the deadline for this. If you miss it, the decision becomes final and binding. If the medical situation is more complex, it may help to get advice from a patient advocacy service (Patientenberatung) or a lawyer specialising in social law before deciding.

remedy.form_text: schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Beispielkasse Ersatzkrankenkasse, Versichertenplatz 3, 20097 Musterhafen
remedy.quote: Sie können gegen diese Entscheidung innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Widerspruch einlegen, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Beispielkasse Ersatzkrankenkasse, Versichertenplatz 3, 20097 Musterhafen.

items.title: File an objection (Widerspruch) against the wheelchair decision
items.action: Decide whether you want to object to the rejection of the electric wheelchair, and if so, submit a written objection or have it recorded in person at Beispielkasse Ersatzkrankenkasse by the deadline shown
items.consequence: If you do not object in time, the decision denying the electric wheelchair and granting only the pushing-aid wheelchair becomes final
items.quote: Sie können gegen diese Entscheidung innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Widerspruch einlegen, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Beispielkasse Ersatzkrankenkasse, Versichertenplatz 3, 20097 Musterhafen.
